evaluation_scope: generated-family out-of-fold rows only; auxiliaries fit only

plan.decision_rule: Compare both seeds against the matched zero-history control and historical corrected hybrid. Report every family fold, phase and style, including full-phase scores. Pooled improvements do not excuse regressions; no evaluation data may be opened from this diagnostic alone.
plan.epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
plan.evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
plan.loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
plan.purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
plan.scope: Training-only fixed-budget causal public-history diagnostic with no overtime override. Existing public spatial features plus changes over 1, 5 and 20 prior decisions, recent damage-race delta and horizon, then current globals. Zero-history control has identical width and parameter count. All folds, seeds, fitting weights and optimizer settings stay fixed. No candidate promotion.
